info.title: Lampo
info.summary: AI inference for agents, paid in sats over Lightning (L402 / MPP).
info.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions. Unauthenticated requests receive 402 Payment Required with a Lightning invoice for a prepaid token bundle; repeat the request with the L402 credential (macaroon:preimage) until the bundle is used up. Prices: https://lampo.run/stats.json

200.description: Completion (JSON, or server-sent events when stream is true).

402.description: Payment required: WWW-Authenticate carries an L402 macaroon and a Lightning invoice for one bundle (and a Payment/MPP challenge).

429.description: The current bundle is still funded but busy with in-flight requests; retry after the Retry-After delay.

Payment.description: Payment HTTP Authentication Scheme (MPP), Lightning charge intent.
